title: Reaper's Embrace
summary: AC 19 Heavy Armour reduces incoming damage by 2 and can block forced movement.

fields.Defence: AC 19. Requires Heavy Armour proficiency, adds no Dexterity modifier and gives Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Magical Plate reduces all incoming damage by 2.
fields.Reaper’s Rigidity: Toggle on to prevent forced movement by spells or actions. While active, you have Disadvantage on Dexterity saves. On by default.
fields.Howl of the Dead: School-less cantrip. Bonus Action affecting creatures within 10 ft, once per Short Rest. DC 14 Wisdom save or Numbed for 3 turns. Numbed halves movement and gives the caster Advantage on attacks against the target. Help or a hit by the caster ends it.
fields.Base value: 6400 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
